name: Late-summer high
story: The last of the summer's warmth: a still, hazy, golden day, the forest smelling of resin, cumulus building lazily over the ridges. The evenings are drawing in now, and the first truly dark nights have come back.
forecast: Warm, 21-22 C in the afternoon. Haze, visibility 25 km. Cumulus over the hills, base 1700 m. Southwest 5-7 kt. Clear, dark night.
